notes.title: Dissident: survival & challenge
notes.content:
Dear Survivors,
Our Dissident team is working hard on the game. We're testing and improving it daily to provide you with the best experience we can think of. What does it mean?

Survival challenges
Providing players with properly designed survival challenges is vital for the game. Expect that guards won't go easy on you if they catch you while trying to escape the camp. You have to be careful also outside the camp - that is if you manage to escape in the first place. Guards will come looking for you. Think twice about setting a campfire in the middle of the night if you don't want to make finding you too easy for them.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753773/8c435c906d454c26ea5d642dc74ddbc2733085bf.jpg

Crafting and exploration
Your backpack will be your best friend. It will allow you to carry less and more precious things out of which you will create tools, igloos, weapons, or clothes. Remember to store some food and water there as well, as you never know when you will need them. 
Exploration will allow you to find new resources, however, it won't be that easy. Wild animals won't forgive you for disturbing their forest sanctuaries. Prepare for a fight, and collect their meat and fur... or die trying. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753773/f5df7b3ac1fad9ddc27bbf5279b040d70ca1dd95.jpg

Add to wishlist
Make sure to add Dissident: Frostland Escape to your Steam wishlist!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1416360/Dissident_Frostland_Escape

Don't freeze, folks! Winter is coming!
Dissident team

notes.title: Hello Dissidents, welcome to...
notes.content:
Hello Dissidents,
I hope you're ready to fight the injustice because we have important information about the game's development.
Let's start with...

The new developer of the game
As some of you might have noticed, the game has a new developer! In December 2022, Sigur Studio took over the development of the game Dissident: Frostland Escape. They began to work anew, using the original assets from Tequilabyte Studio and giving this game a new life.
We cannot express how excited all teams are to show our survival gem to you!
Below, you can find some screenshots from the very early stages of the new production process. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753773/4277f7965397afea8130db5e4f03fb6267d156cc.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38753773/4f5c667cf706db552c0cdc046501b84b676c01ce.png

1984 by Orwell
Did you read 1984 by George Orwell? If you did, you will surely notice some references to this book in Dissident's story. In our opinion, 1984 was one of the ground-breaking pieces of literature that opened the eyes of many. In Dissident's case, we hope that you will get involved with the game's world and reality. We want you to start the rebel! We want you to survive. We want you to succeed... but what do you want?
Because if you want to add this game to your wishlist, just click the button below and join other rebels!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1416360/Dissident_Frostland_Escape/

Your expectations
We're curious about your expectations of Dissident. What features would you like to see in the game? How do you like the vision presented so far? What doesn't seem fun to you? What made the game "click" with you and caught your interest?
Let us know your opinions and hopes in the comments.

Stay and suffer or take the risk and flee, the choice is yours.

Best regards,
Dissident team
